office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes for the state and is legal adviser to the county commissioners, county officers and school districts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Nickolas J. Ward, appointed interim prosecutor from November 2025 after Dale Slack resigned, is the only candidate for both the short and the full term.

candidates.summary: Appointed Columbia County Prosecutor since November 2025, a former Asotin County deputy prosecutor and public defender and a Marine Corps veteran, running with no party preference.
highlights: Appointed by the commissioners in September 2025 to finish Dale Slack's term; started Nov. 1, 2025 [S5]
Former Asotin County deputy prosecutor and felony public defender in four southeast Washington counties [S1]
Says he re-opened the prosecutor's office to the public [S1]
